exposure: hypoplasia or malformation of the cerebellum
low head circumference in the first year of life
low weight in the first six months
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 109 children aged up to 36 months diagnosed with Congenital Zika Syndrome.
finding: The prevalence of drug-resistant epilepsy in children up to 36 months with CZS was 62.4% and was associated with the severity of the child's neurological damage, particularly reduction of brain parenchyma volume and damage to the cerebellum.
